raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "2.0.0"

package:
  name: biotite
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  # Build from the PyPI sdist to avoid `setuptools-scm` omitting all non-source files
  - url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/b/biotite/biotite-${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 0adfb641b1b8879190c5f1e413ec2423cf6fcd7f0739ab62a8ddbca970aa753c
  # The sdist prunes the test suite, so fetch the repository archive for tests.
  - url: https://github.com/biotite-dev/biotite/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 95d16e3b9e9b52a17d8e73a8c7b14d848848ba17fc6a120d04cdc43a542e9c8a
    target_directory: biotite-repo

build:
  skip:
    - match(python, "<3.12")
  number: 0
  script:
    env:
      SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION: ${{ version }}
    content:
      # Bundle the licenses of the vendored Rust dependencies
      - cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml
      - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('rust') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - setuptools
    - setuptools-scm
    - setuptools-rust
  run:
    - python
    - biotraj >=1.0,<2.0
    - requests >=2.12
    - numpy >=2.1
    - msgpack-python >=0.5.6
    - networkx >=2.0
    - packaging >=24

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - biotite
        - biotite.interface.version
      pip_check: true
  - files:
      source:
        - biotite-repo/tests/
    requirements:
      run:
        - pytest
    script: pytest biotite-repo/tests/structure biotite-repo/tests/sequence

about:
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file:
    - LICENSE.rst
    - THIRDPARTY.yml
  summary: A comprehensive library for computational molecular biology
  homepage: https://www.biotite-python.org/
  repository: https://github.com/biotite-dev/biotite
  documentation: https://www.biotite-python.org/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - t0mdavid-m
    - padix-key
